body:
Dear friend,

Mrs. Ruth has been so kind to us. I have an idea for a little surprise for her. Would you please come to the garden?

Bring your best careful fingers!
summary: Make a surprise for Mrs. Ruth with Miss Miriam.
done: Mrs. Ruth has her card, and the hens and the cat are content. How kind of you!

tasks.text: Make a card for Mrs. Ruth and give it to her
Scatter grain for the hens at home
Stroke the cat by the cottage door
